explication: OpenNutriTracker is a private, on-device nutrition and activity tracker. The main workflow is to set up a profile, derive calorie and macro goals, find or scan food, log meals, and review daily and longer-term nutrition. The graph also preserves documented capabilities for recipes, exercise, weight, water, fasting, portability, and theming. Most Flutter feature implementations were not sampled, so those links reflect README statements; the Android workout bridge is supported by the sampled native source.
